fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls, NPC undressing and optional OCum integration. v0.33.1 adds optional bidirectional Procedural Penis Animations synchronization for the verified Accurate Penetration build and fixes the PPA detour layout so the bridge uses near rel32 relay stubs plus unrestricted 64-bit absolute jumps, avoiding ASLR displacement crashes. Unsupported or unreachable layouts disable the integration safely instead of terminating Skyrim.
